question: On photos the gate was not tuned on, does a live Clothes V4 render of a plain long-sleeved top pass the print, colour and stability checks when the bought floral blouse is rendered on the same photo?
scope: Two published synthetic demo people (model-b, model-c) with no recorded render of the bought blouse. Each gets the blouse as reference and the three eligible plain alternatives for the request: quieter print, long sleeves, at most USD 10 extra. Live YouCam Clothes V4 only; one attempt per case; failures are reported, never retried.

models.name: model-b
models.prior_tops_renders: alternatives only in the development pilot; no blouse reference

models.name: model-c
models.prior_tops_renders: alternatives only in the development pilot; no blouse reference

prespecified_outcomes: alternatives with verdict shows / alternatives rendered
alternatives with print ratio at most quiet_ratio / alternatives with a rendered reference
renders with outside change at most stable_pct / renders
plain-top colours within colour_delta / plain tops rendered
reporting_rules: Every case appears once, including failures and unattempted cases.
Thresholds are not changed after seeing results; a threshold that looks wrong is discussed, not moved.
No human fidelity rating is claimed. A pass means the three measurements agree with the request.
